imapHelp: Use a Google App Password with 2-Step Verification. This testing connection reads your Inbox. Confirm the folder to start collecting new mail.
methodDisabled: Your server has disabled this connection method. Intake has stopped. Disconnect this mailbox, then authorize an available OAuth connection. Your candidate data stays available.
noMethods: Your server has disabled mailbox connections.
connectionHelp: Authorize your own mailbox, then confirm its source folder. We collect new email from that point onwards.
fakeNotice: Fake mailbox mode: connections use a local simulation. No external inbox is read.
providerSetup: Your server needs provider settings before this connection is available.
openingRequired: Choose an active opening before connecting a mailbox.
authorized: Mailbox authorized. Confirm the folder to start collecting new CVs.
authorizationFailed: Mailbox authorization did not finish. Start the connection again.
stalled: This mailbox has not synced successfully for over an hour. Check its connection.
emptyIntake: New CV attachments will appear here after collection starts.
name: Candidate name
missingContacts: Email address and phone number are missing.
profileHelp: Professional details come from the CV. Contact corrections keep a record of who changed them and why.
emptyReviews: No identity or contact cases need review.
identityHelp: Check the CV and the suggested candidates before recording a decision. Contact keys remain with their existing owner.
